description: This file defines various loss modules for the PyTorch C++ API (libtorch), including classes for L1Loss, KLDivLoss, MSELoss, BCELoss, HingeEmbeddingLoss, MultiMarginLoss, CosineEmbeddingLoss, SmoothL1Loss, HuberLoss, MultiLabelMarginLoss, SoftMarginLoss, MultiLabelSoftMarginLoss, TripletMarginLoss, TripletMarginWithDistanceLoss, CTCLoss, PoissonNLLLoss, MarginRankingLoss, NLLLoss, CrossEntropyLoss, BCEWithLogitsLoss, and their associated options and module holder classes.

classes.name: L1LossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the L1 Loss module measuring mean absolute error.

classes.name: KLDivLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Kullback-Leibler divergence loss.

classes.name: MSELossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Mean Squared Error loss.

classes.name: BCELossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Binary Cross Entropy loss.

classes.name: HingeEmbeddingLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Hinge Embedding Loss.

classes.name: MultiMarginLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MultiMargin Loss for multi-class hinge loss.

classes.name: CosineEmbeddingLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Cosine Embedding Loss for measuring similarity.

classes.name: SmoothL1LossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Smooth L1 Loss, less sensitive to outliers.

classes.name: HuberLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Huber Loss, combining L1 and L2 behaviors.

classes.name: MultiLabelMarginLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Multi-Label Margin Loss.

classes.name: SoftMarginLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Soft Margin Loss for binary classification.

classes.name: MultiLabelSoftMarginLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Multi-Label Soft Margin Loss.

classes.name: TripletMarginLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Triplet Margin Loss for relative similarity.

classes.name: TripletMarginWithDistanceLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Triplet Margin Loss with a custom distance function.

classes.name: CTCLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Connectionist Temporal Classification Loss.

classes.name: PoissonNLLLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Poisson Negative Log Likelihood Loss.

classes.name: MarginRankingLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Margin Ranking Loss.

classes.name: NLLLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Negative Log Likelihood Loss.

classes.name: CrossEntropyLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Cross Entropy Loss.

classes.name: BCEWithLogitsLossImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BCE with Logits Loss.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Prints the module details into a stream.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Computes the loss given input and target tensors.
